'''Verusa''', officially the '''Federal Republic of Verusa''',  is a country in northern [[Ayuma]]. It nect to the [[Rianian Ocean]]. Its thirteen constituent states have a total [[List of countries and dependencies by population|population of over 69 million]] in an area of [[List of countries and dependencies by area|730,606 km2 (282,089 sq mi)]] making it the [[List of countries and dependencies by population|sixth most populous country on Ayuma]]. Verusa borders [[Fermori]] to the north, [[Uularin]] and the [[Lydroa]] to the east, [[Darewa]] and [[Siana]] to the south, and [[Palina]], and [[Yaxuto]] to the west. The nation's capital and most populous city is [[Huifarn]] and its largest urban area is the [[Epass]].

[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Human_settlement Settlement] in the territory of modern Verusa began in the Lower ____, with various tribes inhabiting it from the ___onward, chiefly the [[Surtians tribes|Surtians]] and [[Suebi tribes|Suebi]]. Various [[Suebi tribes]] have inhabited the northern parts of western Verusa since the [[classical era]]. A region named [[Mitre]] was documented before AFA 100. In 660, the [[Vulime Empire]] was the bulk of the [[United Verusan Realm]] . During the 12th century, eastern Verusan regions became the centre of the [[Pyesion]]. Following the [[Seniaaii revolution|Seniaaii revolutionary wars]] and the weakening of the [[United Verusan Realm]] and after the [[Great Central war]], the [[Verusan Empire]] was formed in 1629.

Formal [[unification of Verusa]] into the modern nation-state commenced in 1630  with the [[Verusan Unification Treaty]] establishing a [[Huifarn]] lead [[Verusan Empire]], which became the. After the [[Great Imperial War]] and the [[Verusa Revolution]] of 1671, the Empire became a [[wikipedia:Constitutional_monarchy|constitutional monarchy]]. The people's rise to power in 1684 led to the establishment of the [[wikipedia:Two-party_system|two party state]]. In 1702, after the war and a period of turmoil, Verusa was organised into a full [[wikipedia:Federal_republic|Federal Republic]] with full sovereignty. the Federal Republic of Verusa was one of the major participants of the [[Red War]] from which it emerged victorious at [[Deaths in Red war|great human and economic cost]] from being nearly totally [[wikipedia:Military_occupation|occupied]]. Following the end of the war, the short-lived [[First Verusan republic|first Republic]] was established and later dissolved in the aftermath [[reinstatement of mandatory service]]. The current third Republic was formed in 1760. Many of its former colonies still have close economic and cultural ties.

Verusa is a [[developed country]] with a strong economy; it has the [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|ninth economy in the world by nominal GDP.]] As a major force in several industrial, scientific and [[wikipedia:Technology|technological]] sectors, Verusa is both the world's eighth-largest exporter and eighth-largest importer. It offers [[wikipedia:Welfare_spending|social security]], a [[wikipedia:Universal_health_care|universal health care system]], and tuition-free [[wikipedia:University|university education]]. Widely considered a great power, Verusa is part of multiple international organisations and forums and has [[List of countries by Krali Total Development Index|the highest Krali Total Development Index]] out of any country It has the fifth-highest number of [[Global Heritage Sites]]: 45, of which 38 are cultural.
